Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Mathematical Biology and Population Dynamics
  • Host Institution: University of Birmingham
  • Department: School of Mathematics
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: College or EPSRC scholarship (competitive)
  • Stipend: UKRI rate
  • Tuition Fees: Covered (subject to scholarship)
  • Eligibility: UK, EU, International, and self-funded applicants
  • Application Deadline: 24 October 2026
  • Note: CSC scholarships available for Chinese students

Project Description

This project involves developing mathematical models to study population dynamics in biological systems. The research will combine dynamical systems theory, mathematical modelling, and data-driven methods to explore how populations change over time in response to ecological interactions, environmental changes, and other biological processes.

How to Apply

Apply via the relevant Mathematics/Biosciences PhD programme. Informal enquiries to the supervisor are strongly encouraged.
